_comment: Category -> HS Code + Country of Origin lookup, transcribed from Neil's 'HS Code and Country of Origin .xlsx' (2026-08-12). Neil's rule: the HS Code is always constant per category; Country of Origin can vary within a category for the categories he flagged. Two distinct handling mechanisms for that variance, per category: 'sku_prefix_rules' (a real per-SKU rule exists -- Lampwork Beads' P120x/I0x split, confirmed 2026-08-12), or a plain 'note' (the variance is about a DIFFERENT sub-item than what's actually onboarded today, so the default is safe to auto-apply as-is -- Tools & Stringing Materials, where only Leather Cord is onboarded and its country is confirmed). Keys are Neil's own category label text (cleaned), used as the match target from spreadsheet_type_id/collection -- see HS_COI_CATEGORY_MAP in app.py for that cross-reference. country_code is the Shopify CountryCode enum value (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), verified live against the real Shopify schema. 'covers_live_collections' (when present) lists real Shopify collection handles this category's values were actually pushed to live, for categories that don't have a 1:1 spreadsheet_type_id match.

Glass Rhinestones.note: Confirmed by Neil 2026-08-13: 'their own Product Category'. Pushed live to the 3 collections grouped under the storefront's 'Machine Cut & Glass Rhinestones' card: preciosa-jablonex-czech-glass-extra-2-cut, silver-foiled-flatback, hot-fix-flatback (~32 products total). Note: an earlier session flagged a separate ~160-product legacy 'Rhinestones' catch-all group (example SKU 11110-8ss-00030) that doesn't obviously match this 32-product figure -- unclear if that's the same thing as this category or something else entirely; not resolved, just proceeding with the confirmed 3 collections since Neil confirmed the category itself, not product scope.

Lampwork Beads.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-12 by Neil (via Yair): the P120xx/I0xxx split belongs to Lampwork Beads, NOT Seed Beads -- it was originally misread because the note sat in the Seed Beads row of Neil's sheet, but Neil confirmed directly 'The P120xx numbers are the lampwork from China. Nothing to do with seed beads.' Matches the sheet's own SKU range for this category (P12050 - P12091, i.e. the P120xx pattern) and the earlier 'some lampwork beads are also from India' note -- both now resolved by the same rule: P120x-prefixed = PROC, I0xxx-prefixed = India, anything else defaults to PROC. Nothing onboarded under this category yet, so untested against real data.

Seed Beads.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-12: no per-SKU exception here after all -- the P120xx/I0xxx rule previously listed here actually belongs to Lampwork Beads (see above), moved per Neil's direct correction. Seed Beads is a plain Czech Republic default, no exception. Confirmed by Neil 2026-08-13: the Sales & Clearance collection's 3 products are Preciosa Ornela Seed Beads ("CLEARANCE SEED HANK 7/0 ... PRECIOSA ORNELA BEADS") -- covered under this category's values too, not left blank.

Rosemontees & Stones in Settings.note: Confirmed by Neil 2026-08-13: ChatonMontees (the live rim-chatonmontee collection, 5 products) is a subcategory of this, same HS code and country -- 'any items we put in this category are the same HS code and country origin'.

Metal Beads.note: Neil's sheet note just labels this row 'Aluminum Filigree Beads' -- the Metal Beads collection currently = Filigree Beads (the only type onboarded there so far), not a stated COI exception.

Metal Buttons.note: Neil, 2026-08-12: Buttons will get more sub-categories later -- Rhinestone Buttons (Czech Republic) coming to the site, possibly Czech Glass Buttons in stock too. Neither has its own HS code yet (buttons are a different HS category than loose rhinestones/beads, don't assume 7018-10-2000). Get the real HS code from Neil when either is actually onboarded -- not needed yet, only Metal Buttons is live.

Tools & Stringing Materials.note: Leather Cord specifically is confirmed India -- matches the default here directly, safe to auto-apply to the live Leather Cord products (the only type onboarded under this category so far). Neil's note: 'other stringing materials can be from different countries' -- if a non-Leather-Cord stringing material is onboarded later, give it its own confirmed country before relying on this India default for it.
